$Comment:
The Sawmiller's Hatchet chase: the one roll that hands over the sawmill's trophy tool. It is the only roll in this file, which is what makes it cheap to re-tune - a Lootable folds by id and a later layer replaces the whole file, so a mod or pack wanting different odds ships its own Server/ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/SawmillTrophy.json and inherits nothing else along with it. Only one version of a given id is ever live, so an override cannot accidentally hand out two hatchets.

The chance here is flat on purpose: one visible Chance.Base with no factors, so the odds read at a glance and hold for every worker. If you want the chase to reward some notion of luck or progression, that is exactly what an override is for - add Chance.Factors reading whichever stat channels your own mod registers.

The Conditions AND together. Cycle 5 onward, so a passer-by tapping the bench never rolls. Then all three tool axes at the vanilla Mithril hatchet's own values: quality 4 (Epic or better), item level 50, and Woods gather power 0.5, read through the Param-less hytale:tool_power form that takes the station's own gather type. Onyxium clears quality and power but misses item level, so this stays the top rung's trophy rather than the top floor's.

Chance.Base 0.04 IS 1 in 2500, so an eligible worker averages one trophy per 2500 cycles, on the order of one per twenty-five full sessions - a genuine chase item.

The win grants through this roll's own Grants.Items: one RPG_Tool_Hatchet_Sawmiller, handed straight to the worker (hotbar first, then the backpack) and dropped at the station block when the bag is full, so the payout is certain once the chance lands. Because it is an item grant, the hatchet is reported as station output like any other stack the mill pays: a listening mod can count it, and an objective naming the hatchet advances on it. The Cue plays at the station block only when the hatchet actually landed in the bag or on the ground; a grant that reached neither (no room and the drop failed) is not a win, so the fanfare stays silent rather than celebrating an empty hand.

The reward compounds at the bench: a Sawmiller's Hatchet in hand scores 55.55 on the Mill action's yield ladder, which unlocks its 50 floor for a fifth plank per cycle, the matching contribution tier, and the fourth find tier in SawmillMasterworkFinds.
